about: Canada's regional 'Avoid all travel' blocks the stay spots were checked against (Global Affairs Canada's feed of 2026-10-15, then its live feed on 2026-10-18): per country, each block by its heading, a fingerprint of its words, and the places inside it that never become stay anchors. Under 'us', the same for the US State Department's regional 'Do not travel' areas where it names them (its RSS feed of 2026-10-18): per country below level 4, a fingerprint of the feed's 'Do Not Travel to' words and the places inside an area they name. scripts/gen_stay_spots.py --check flags a block or a US list that is new, gone or reworded.
